_comment: INDUSTRIAL: a painted hazard band, the kit's signature. Almost no geometry at all - a yellow strip with five dark bars across it - because it is PAINT, and the point of it is that it draws the straight edges of a hull in safety yellow. Long axis is +Z, so `align: Run` lays it down the edge it stands on. It RAISES ITS OWN FOOTPRINT BUDGET to 0.92 of a cell, which no other piece here does: a stripe is a LINE, and at the default half-cell budget consecutive plates of one edge come out as a row of dashes rather than as a painted edge. It is the one piece worth spending the seam on.
